description: Golden questions for the SOP index: each names the SOP a care team member would need. Questions are phrased the way staff talk, often without the SOP's own words, so they test meaning, not keyword overlap. scripts/eval-agents.sh retrieval sends each one to the live procedure-search function (real Titan V2 embeddings) and scores the answers.
